ambient_events: Something under the counter is quietly ticking.
A hand-lettered sign reads: WE ASK NO QUESTIONS. PLEASE RETURN THE FAVOUR.
description: A narrow shop behind wire-mesh glass, every shelf crowded with other people's bad weeks. A buzz-lock door, a bulletproof slot in the counter, and a back room whose contents are strictly none of your business.

window.description: A window behind a welded grille, which lets in the light in strips and the view in pieces. Better than nothing, which was the brief.
window.name: the barred window

name: Pawn & Pity
